name: Orange Tunisie Data Center Kalaa Kebira
notes: Next-generation Tier III-quality data center at Kalaa Kebira, Sousse governorate, inaugurated 2025-05-05 by Orange Tunisie in presence of Communication Technologies Minister Sofiene Hemissi; ~1,000 m2 site built by Tunisian companies; serves Orange internal needs and B2B cloud/hosting. Orange official page is A for facility/date/locality; 1,000 m2 and Tier III-quality corroborated by ilboursa/Tunisie Tribune (B).

name: EO Data Center Enfidha (Meninx)
notes: Carrier-neutral colocation/sovereign-cloud data center in Zone Industrielle d'Enfidha, Sousse governorate (near Enfidha-Hammamet airport); Tier III design, NCloud-labelled, ISO 27001/PCI-DSS per operator page; ~1 MW installed power and ~250-1,000 m2 halls per secondary sources (B). Near subsea landing points; partners incl. IBM, Orange Tunisie, Tunisie Telecom.

name: Syntys Sousse Data Center
notes: Iron Mountain official Syntys joint-venture page lists Sousse among Tunisia locations (Mghira, Charguia, Manouba, Sidi Rezig, Sousse). New lead for Sousse governorate; no public facility-level page found, capacity/locality within governorate unconfirmed.

name: STEG Data Center Sfax
developer: STEG (Societe Tunisienne de l'Electricite et du Gaz)
notes: STEG-owned data center in Sfax; engineering firm BIMDC portfolio states renovation of the datacenter technical installations (execution dossiers), 350 m2, completed 2024. Evidence is a consultant portfolio entry (C-grade), not an official STEG announcement; capacity not disclosed.
